title: Lowpoly Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: Migrate the 💠️lowpoly plugin (W2 batch) from its old 7-crate constitutional layout (bundle/manifest crate + app facade crate + 6 module crates: engine, pack, protocol, op, ui, dsl — single app "lowpoly", single artifact) into ONE crate at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/💠️lowpoly/📦️packages/🦀️rust/ with the full taxonomy source tree per TEMPLATE.md (crate name preserved: semio-s-plugin-lowpoly). Follow the ordered recipe: inventory, baseline tests + wire format, taxonomy tree write, app_commands! decomposition, verification (cargo check native+wasm32-wasip2, clippy -D warnings, cargo test), delete old crates, registrar handoff report. Special note: engine crate's old Cargo.toml has a [dev-dependencies] entry on cad_plugin (already repointed to semio-s-plugin-cad by a prior batch-1 agent) used in a test module importing cad_plugin::artifacts::cad::engine::geometry_import::{objects_from_fixture_model, parse_geometry} — must carry this dev-dependency forward into the new merged crate's [dev-dependencies], same import path. Also check whether lowpoly is really 3 apps (2d/3d/5d) as initially assumed or a single app (verify on disk first).
summary:
Migrated 💠️lowpoly from its old 7-crate constitutional layout (bundle/manifest + app facade + engine/pack/protocol/op/ui/dsl) into ONE crate `semio-s-plugin-lowpoly` at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/💠️lowpoly/📦️packages/🦀️rust/ with the full taxonomy source tree (artifacts/apps/commands/modes/windows/options/panels). Disk verification (per CLAUDE.md's "validate, don't assume" rule) showed lowpoly is a SINGLE app named "lowpoly" with 6 constitutional module crates + manifest — NOT 3 apps (2d/3d/5d) as the task briefing assumed; that assumption belonged to a different plugin (procedural), not lowpoly. Corrected old-code corruption found during migration: the old 🖱️ui crate had the same repo-wide automated corruption pattern as cad/vcs/shooting/sourcing/animate (Ok( wrapping without closing parens on Emit constructors) — fixed as part of the natural port, distinguishing helpers that return bare Emit (mesh_edit, LowpolyScratch methods) from handlers that must return Result<Emit,Fault> per app_commands!. Consolidated the old ui crate's 7 RefCell fields into one RefCell<LowpolyScratch> (mirrors flow's Mutex<FlowEvalSession> pattern). Decomposed the monolithic LowpolyCommand enum into 56 app_commands! rows across 14 command-group files; kept LowpolyConfigOperation as a single undecomposed enum (moved verbatim to app config.rs) since it's not part of app_commands!. Design decisions flagged for orchestrator review: (1) two windows (Model=World3d, UV=Canvas2d) share byte-for-byte identical measures/engagement across a MODE boundary (Model used by both edit and paint modes) — extended TEMPLATE.md §12.2's mode-level shared-options pattern one level up to APP-level 🎚️options (6 option components) since no single mode owns both windows; (2) split the 1202-line old engine crate into 3 sibling files (component.rs core session, paint.rs pixel compute, media.rs export/import + the cad-dependent test) to stay under the plan's ~800-line NoUiGodfile guidance. Carried forward the cad_plugin dev-dependency exactly as instructed (path repointed to ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📐️cad/📦️packages/🦀️rust, package semio-s-plugin-cad, same test-module import path cad_plugin::artifacts::cad::engine::geometry_import::{objects_from_fixture_model, parse_geometry}) — confirmed still compiling and the fixture-model test still passes. Fixed the one repo-wide cross-cutting dependent: 🧰️framework/.../🗣️dsl/🧪️fixture-sweep's Cargo.toml + lib.rs dev-depended on the deleted semio-s-app-lowpoly facade crate for LowpolyProjection — repointed to semio-s-plugin-lowpoly, path crate::artifacts::lowpoly::LowpolyProjection (same pattern an already-migrated sibling, sequence, used in the same file). Repo-wide grep confirms no other Cargo.toml (dependencies or dev-dependencies) still references any old semio-s-app-lowpoly* crate name except root Cargo.toml (registrar's job); 🎪️demonstrator has no lowpoly dependency. Verification, all synchronous (never backgrounded past the harness's own auto-timeout, which I actively polled through rather than treating as fire-and-forget): cargo check native — clean, zero warnings attributable to this crate. cargo check --target wasm32-wasip2 — clean. cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings — clean after fixing ~24 real findings (map_unwrap_or→map_or/map_or_else mechanical fixes, chunks_exact→as_chunks, redundant clones in test code, too_many_arguments/needless_pass_by_value/large_enum_variant allow-with-reason on the same justified spots the template calls out, one genuine module_inception avoided by keeping the two lone-command groups' payloads at file top level instead of a same-named inner mod). cargo test — 137/137 passed (135 authored + 2 framework plugin-sanity tests), versus an old-code textual baseline of 109 #[test] fns across the 7 old crates (old 🖱️ui crate's tests never actually compiled pre-migration due to the corruption above, matching the batch-1-documented pattern). Wire-format byte-identical proof: added a temporary [DEBUG] test to the OLD protocol crate (isolated via the same temporary-workspace-overlay trick used for the new crate, since the OLD crate also sits inside the currently-red root workspace from unrelated concurrent churn) printing text+hex for 10 representative LowpolyCommand values spanning None/Some options, a Vec field, nested coords, a unit variant, and a late-ordinal variant; diffed byte-for-byte identical against the same 10 values constructed as the new decomposed LowpolyCommand — saved as 🧪️wire-baseline-before.txt/🧪️wire-baseline-after.txt in this ticket folder. Deleted old crates only after all of the above passed. Re-checked for a rival LOWPOLY-PLUGIN-MIGRATION ticket and unfamiliar files in the plugin directory three times across the session (before starting deletion, and again just before ticket close) — none found; only my own ticket/session throughout.
